## Master-plan id

F-xxx or "not in the plan". Plan checkboxes stay unchecked until the
definition of done is met.

## Who is at the host, and what do they consent to?

A feature that controls another computer needs an explicit consent story.
An invite ticket, a short code, a LAN browse, or a DHT record is not
permission. Hidden or stealth behavior will not be accepted. Quick Support
cannot enable unattended access. The session indicator has no off switch.

## Languages

User-facing strings need the same keys in `app/i18n/en.json` and
`app/i18n/tr.json`.

## Out of scope
